body:
Adds `research/anytime-liquidity`: LMSR with time-varying liquidity as anytime Hedge. b_t = c*·√t costs exactly √2 over the horizon-aware bound, doubling is 1.70× worse than the continuous schedule, and self-tuning liquidity makes the subsidy track the accumulated mixability gap. Includes code, 10 tests, experiments, white paper, README and portfolio entries.
